subject: SDLC artifacts requested for SOC 2: change control + secrets evidence
messages:
From: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDLC evidence for upcoming SOC 2 assessment

Marissa,

Hope you are well. Acme Health's external assessor has asked for Secure SDLC evidence tied to code review, CI/CD controls, secrets management, and change approvals for the services Redwood will be in-scope for. Specifically they asked for:

- A short index that maps each artifact to the control (e.g., code review policy -> PR workflow; change control -> Jira approvals)
- Exports of change-approval logs for the past 12 months (who approved what and when)
- CI/CD pipeline configs showing gated deployments and artifact signing/verification
- Evidence that secrets are stored/rotated (rotation policies, KMS usage), and any exception logs

Can you let me know what you can provide and how quickly? We have a submission window next week (deadline 2026-07-10). If you prefer, we can accept a secure Drive link or an SFTP upload.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Sanders
Lead IT Auditor, Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for upcoming SOC 2 assessment

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the requested artifacts and will prioritize the change-approval logs and CI/CD pipeline configs. Initial plan:

1) Send an index CSV that maps artifacts to controls and locations (attached: SDLC_evidence_index.csv).
2) Provide a CSV export of change approvals for the requested period (we expect to attach change_control_logs_export_2026-07-06.csv).
3) Include CI/CD config snippets and a pipeline doc (ci_cd_pipeline_config.yml attached; full pipeline link below).
4) Provide a short writeup on secrets management: KMS usage, rotation cadence, and exception handling.

Which transfer method do you prefer? We can either: (A) upload a read-only folder to a secure Google Drive share, or (B) place the artifacts on an SFTP endpoint you provide. If Drive is acceptable I'll share a time-limited folder link.

ETA: I can share the index + the first exports by EOD 2026-07-06, then follow up with the remaining items the next day. If your assessor needs anything redacted, flag it and we'll accommodate.

-M

--
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SDLC_evidence_index.csv (index of artifacts; control mapping)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for upcoming SOC 2 assessment

Marissa — quick notes on where to pull artifacts and a couple of gotchas:

- Change approvals: export from Jira (project INFRA-CHG). Use the REST export > CSV filtered by the "Approver" workflow step. File we produce: change_control_logs_export_2026-07-06.csv. It contains approver, timestamp, change id, environment, and related PR/commit.
- Code review: PR history lives in GitHub (org: redwoodinference; repo: infra and several service repos). For sample evidence include: PRs that enforced required reviewers and required CI checks. Link example commit: https://github.com/redwoodinference/infra/commit/9f3b2d
- CI/CD: pipeline definitions are in GitLab (group: redwood-cicd). The gated deployment stage and signature verification job are in ci_cd_pipeline_config.yml (attached). Also include the pipeline run logs for 3 representative releases.
- Secrets: primary storage in AWS KMS + parameter-store with encryption; rotation is automated via monthly rotation jobs for service keys and quarterly rotation for signing keys. Do NOT export actual secrets. Provide screenshots/rotation logs and KMS key policy excerpts.

Operational note: redact user email aliases for any PII if the assessor prefers. Also, the SFTP option requires us to open a temporary firewall rule — Drive link is faster for a tight deadline.

I'll gather the three pipeline run logs and push to the folder once Marissa creates it.

-Rohan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for upcoming SOC 2 assessment

Tom —

Per our plan, I uploaded a time-limited, read-only folder to Google Drive and shared it with security@acmehealth.com. Folder contents (high level):

- SDLC_evidence_index.csv (index and mapping to controls)
- change_control_logs_export_2026-07-06.csv (Jira export of approval steps)
- ci_cd_pipeline_config.yml (pipeline config with gated deploys)
- pipeline_run_logs_sample-202605, pipeline_run_logs_sample-202606, pipeline_run_logs_sample-202607 (pipeline run artifacts)
- secrets_management_writeup.pdf (rotation cadence and KMS usage; sensitive fields redacted)

Drive link (expires 2026-07-14): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSDLC-ARTIFACTS

Notes / controls mapping excerpt:
- CC1 (Change Management): change_control_logs_export_2026-07-06.csv -> shows approver usernames, timestamps, and links to PRs
- SD1 (Secure Development): PR policies + pipeline gate enforcement -> code review examples in GitHub links in index
- SEC3 (Secrets): secrets_management_writeup.pdf & KMS policy excerpts -> show rotation and limited access

If the assessor needs the raw pipeline logs packaged differently, tell me preferred format and we can re-export.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: change_control_logs_export_2026-07-06.csv; ci_cd_pipeline_config.yml

From: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Health Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for upcoming SOC 2 assessment

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the Drive link. I can see the index and the exported CSVs. A couple of quick follow-ups from the assessor: can you also provide the formal approval record for a sample production change (the approval email/record tied to INFRA-CHG-1723) and the pipeline run log that shows the signature verification step (the assessor wants the step-by-step output for that job).

If you can toss those into the same Drive folder or share them directly with me, that should close the loop for our submission. Deadline still 2026-07-10.

Appreciate it —
Tom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 23:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for upcoming SOC 2 assessment

Tom —

Will do. I pulled the approval record for INFRA-CHG-1723 and the signature-verification pipeline job output; they're being redacted for internal emails and uploaded now. You should see two new files in the Drive folder within the next hour: INFRA-CHG-1723-approval-record.pdf and pipeline_signature_job_output_1723.txt.

If anything else is required I can escalate to Rohan to provide additional logs.

Thanks,
Marissa
